constants.rows_seed: default_rng([EVAL_SEED = 1, 72]), natural texts (pcfg.sample_texts), the same rows for every state. amend1 used [1, 70] (its rows) and [1, 71] (its formula check). Disjoint: no text of the 20,000 equals any of amend1's 8,000 (checked in code, a control; measured 0 before filing).

amend1.rows_seed: default_rng([EVAL_SEED = 1, 70]), natural texts (pcfg.sample_texts), the same rows for every state
amend1.hi_note: hi is the fraction of the way from a read's constant floor f to 1 (rule_label), not an absolute share

trajectory.note: trajectory states: one run per seed sampled at six steps; context, not independent anchors
